hardware: SpacemiT K3 Pico ITX / eight A100 cores / 31 GiB RAM
build: standalone SPACEMIT0; v0.2.5 (5105f9dfb); spine-runtime 0.7.2; same native Bianbu GCC 15.2 Release build for all controlled variants
protocol: Single slot, context 1024, threads and batch threads 8, batch and microbatch 128. Six requests with 128 uncached input tokens / 128 greedy output tokens. Exclude the first, take the median of five. Three independent control process launches. Separate 197 Hz user-mode perf pass for each, 1 input token / 128 output tokens. Classify the actual shared-object / ELF symbol containing each sample; categories count CPU instruction-pointer samples, not unit occupancy. Benchmarks after board restart used a 26 GiB cgroup limit and host-memory watchdog.

copy_probe.allocations: Eight separate 4 MiB vendor MMZ blocks. Ordinary DDR is a separate RVV control. Tile-owned TCM from alloc_shared. Two final destination buffers checked bytewise for each tile per round. Outer median of the slowest worker mean time per transfer.

method_key.restartLeader: small contiguous routing op runs on tile zero
method_key.restartGate: bounded-spin rendezvous with cooperative fallback; inline spin may move samples outside named synchronization functions
method_key.capRVV: new MMZ tile schedule, RVV copy control
method_key.capDMA: same tile schedule, at most one in-flight AIDMA request, RVV on busy/rejected lane; <=128 KiB per transfer
method_key.privateA: duplicate the short single-token activation quantization into per-worker TCM

unbounded_dma_trial.outcome: failed to finish first measured request; no speed or correctness claim
unbounded_dma_trial.memory_recovery: A later load encountered system MemAvailable=0. After stopping the experiment, about 11.8 GiB was available despite no running model; the device was restarted. The exact cause of the memory state was not established.

decision: No kernel PR. The capped DMA path completed and passed the output checks but was slower. The initial best non-DMA candidate did not beat its reversed-order control. The broad pipeline failed the full-model timeout.
